reuse.why: Extends the existing pre-link guard that every provider link function already calls, instead of adding checks to each provider.

duplication.why: No duplicated logic added; the guard does a second read of the upgrading account that each link function also reads right after, a small redundancy.

placement.why: The validation lives in the shared pre-link assertion in accounts/app.ts, the layer that already enforces the linking rules.

scope.why: Focused on the rule plus tests; the rename of the guard across six call sites is justified by its widened meaning but adds churn.

maintainability.why: A single guard owns all link preconditions, so future providers inherit the closed-account rule automatically.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All six provider link functions go through assertCanLinkBankAccount.

one_place.where: assertCanLinkBankAccount in server/accounts/app.ts, called by the GoCardless, SimpleFin, Pluggy, Akahu, Fintegra and EnableBanking link functions.
